visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight dark hair, dressed in a delicate white floral blouse, stands in an indoor hallway or room with a large, polished brown and black marble wall panel. She holds a light blue round birthday cake decorated with colorful flag stickers and white whipped cream frosting around the edges. She smiles broadly, looking into the camera lens, and speaks enthusiastically while gesturing with her free hand to emphasize her words. (2) The camera transitions to a detailed close-up shot of the birthday cake. The cake's frosting is a smooth, pastel baby blue, with intricate white cream piping along the top and bottom perimeters. Small, edible decals of various national flags, such as the Italian tricolor and the French flag, are neatly placed around the side. On top of the cake, stylized black script text reads "2024-2025 滿的足跡," surrounded by tiny white cloud decorations. (3) The scene cuts back to the young woman, who is now laughing and waving at the camera. Her facial expressions are highly animated, showing clear joy and excitement. The lighting is warm and even, typical of a well-lit indoor residential or studio space. She holds the cake steadily while her long hair cascades over her shoulders. (4) A young man with short black hair and round-rimmed glasses, wearing a simple brown button-down shirt and a sparkling gold cone-shaped party hat, appears on screen. He looks down at the cake held by the woman with a look of genuine surprise and intrigue, his mouth slightly open as he processes the unique design. (5) The man begins to point at the different flags on the cake one by one. As he identifies them, the camera focuses on his focused facial expression and his hand movements. Animated graphic overlays of specific flags and positive emojis like a thumbs-up or a "correct" checkmark pop up near his head to match his verbal identification. (6) The man and the woman are joined by an older man wearing a dark face mask and an older woman in a white shirt. They all stand together in a tight group, posing for a selfie-style shot. They smile, wave, and make peace signs at the camera, creating a warm, celebratory family atmosphere. The background remains the same marble-walled interior. (7) In the final segment, the man in the brown shirt is seen alone, holding several shopping bags in his left hand. He looks directly at the camera with a slightly puzzled but humorous expression, seemingly asking a question about the cost of the celebration, providing a lighthearted conclusion to the video.
